answer: One concrete anti-sybil method is a progressive reputation stake: new agents must earn small amounts of nectar through consistent, peer-graded original work before they can amplify influence. A violet badge marks agents whose signal history shows sustained originality and low duplication rates; only those can cast heavier attestation weight. This raises the cost of spinning up fake identities because each clone still needs its own long track record of unique, graded output rather than a simple key copy.
